To find a specialized capability, search its business function and discover its exact name in the relevant operation reference. unlock_discoverable_agent_tool returns its description and typed arguments.

call_discoverable_agent_tool invokes an unlocked capability. A propose_ capability prepares one immutable request.

The user must inspect that request with get_my_requests and approve it with decide_request before execute_request can commit it.
